camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --PageSize 10 --NextToken TGlzdFJlc291cm000 --CurrentPage 1 --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000
description_en: Queries the list of all devices under a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品下的所有设备列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --current-page 1 --next-token TGlzdFJlc291cm000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是50。默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices belong
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的设备所属产品的ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页的内容。默认值是 1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the NextToken value returned from the previous query.



When the product of PageSize and CurrentPage is greater than 10,000, you must specify NextToken. Otherwise, no data is returned.


<notice>
If you specify NextToken, the product of PageSize and CurrentPage must be less than 1,000,000. Otherwise, no data is returned.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
下一页标识，首次查询无需传入。后续查询需使用的NextToken，要从上一次查询的返回结果中获取。



当PageSize×CurrentPage值大于10,000时，必须传入NextToken。否则，无法返回数据。


<notice>
如果传入NextToken值，则PageSize×CurrentPage值必须小于1,000,000。否则，无法返回数据。

</notice>
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

DeviceInfo.description_en:
The list of device information (DeviceInfo) returned if the call is successful.
The returned device information is sorted in reverse chronological order by device creation time
DeviceInfo.description_zh:
调用成功时，返回设备信息列表（DeviceInfo）。
返回的设备信息按照设备创建时间倒序排列

DeviceId.description_en:
The device ID (legacy parameter).

This parameter is a legacy parameter that has no practical use and cannot be used to identify a device. Currently, the valid device identifiers are IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName
DeviceId.description_zh:
设备ID（旧版参数）。

该参数是旧版本遗留参数，已无实际作用，不能用来标识设备。目前，有效的设备标识符为IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合

DeviceStatus.description_en:
The device status. Valid values:
ONLINE: The device is online.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
UNACTIVE: The device is not activated.
DISABLE: The device is disabled
DeviceStatus.description_zh:
设备状态。取值：
ONLINE：设备在线。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
UNACTIVE：设备未激活。
DISABLE：设备已禁用

DeviceType.description_en:
The category of the product to which the device belongs.

This parameter is not returned
DeviceType.description_zh:
设备所属产品的品类。

目前不返回此参数

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the device was created, in GMT format

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the device information was last updated, in GMT format
GmtModified.description_zh: 设备信息最后一次更新时的时间，GMT格式

IotId.description_en: The device ID. The ID issued by IoT Platform for the device. This is the unique identifier of the device
IotId.description_zh: 设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the device was created, in UTC format

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the device information was last updated, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: 设备信息最后一次更新时的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next page. You can pass this value in the next request to retrieve the next page of data.

If NextToken is empty, no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh:
下一页标识。可在下次请求时传入，来获取下一页数据。

如果NextToken值为空，表示没有下一页数据

PageSize.description_en: The number of devices displayed per page

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
